name: omnilab/noaa
description: Omnilab NOAA: weather and climate observations as series at a point - the station records of the world from NCEI's Access Data Service (GHCN-Daily by day, the Global Summary of the Month and of the Year: TMAX, TMIN, TAVG, PRCP, SNOW, AWND... in metric units) at the nearest station that has them or at a station named, and, for a point of the United States, the National Weather Service's observations of the nearest station (seven days back) joined to its grid's forecast (seven days ahead); no key.
